# event aspect

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventAspect`](gmeow-eventAspect.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventAspect>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

The grammatical aspect of a textual mention of the event (ISO-TimeML EVENT @aspect). Annotation-layer only; orthogonal to the event's actual temporal placement.
